series.saveHint: A club with results cannot be removed.

events.title: Events
events.setupHint: only pre-computed combinations — a new one takes minutes to draw, not seconds
events.catalogEmptyText: No predefined size is available yet.
events.catalogContactHint: Need a size that isn't listed? Have it added by
events.formatText: {{teams}} teams on {{boats}} boats = {{races}} races per flight, {{total}} races in {{flights}} flights.
events.seedHint: Shuffles starting positions deterministically — the same seed always gives the same draw, useful if a draw needs to be proven later.
events.clubsFromSeriesHint: This event belongs to a series, so only clubs registered for that series can enter.
events.clubsAnyHint: This event stands on its own, so any club can enter.
events.clubsSeriesEmptyText: No club is registered for this series yet. Register them for the series first, then enter them here.
events.clubsFrozenHint: Racing has started — the field is fixed, because the pairing list being sailed was drawn for exactly these clubs.
events.clubsCountHint: The setup expects {{expected}} clubs; {{actual}} are entered.
events.drawBlockedHint: The draw is refused until the setup is complete. Go back and fix it, or skip it for now and finish in the panel below.
events.finishLaterHint: The event is saved. Everything still missing can be added later in the panel below.
events.publishToShareHint: Publish the event to open its pairing list and download the PDF.
events.flightsHint: 1 to {{max}}: the stored list's length; a shorter day sails its first flights

squad.teamEmptyText: No one has registered for this team yet.

auth.notSignedInError: You must be signed in to access administration.

manage.title: Run an event
manage.description: Everything after the name: the date once the host confirms it, the clubs, the draw, publication, and the start. Drafts are listed here too — the public calendar shows only what has been published.
manage.emptyText: No events have been created yet.
manage.readyMessage: Ready: this event can be drawn and started.
manage.frozenMessage: Racing has started ({{races}} races under way, {{results}} results recorded), so the setup is fixed. Results stay editable — a protest decision months later is exactly what the race-committee screen is for.
manage.clubsFromSeriesHint: Only clubs registered for {{series}} can enter one of its events — that is what the series registration is.
manage.clubsStandaloneHint: This event belongs to no series, so any club can enter.
manage.seriesHasNoClubs: This event's series has no registered clubs yet. Register them with the series first.
manage.noClubsAtAll: No clubs exist yet. Create one above first.
manage.pairingExistsHint: A pairing list exists. Drawing again replaces it — possible until the first race starts.
manage.pairingMissingHint: No pairing list yet. The draw takes the pre-computed list for this size and shuffles the starting positions with the seed.
manage.drawNeedsReadyHint: The draw needs a complete setup — see "Still missing" above.
manage.publishHint: Publishing decides who can see the event; it locks nothing and does not require the event to be complete. A published event stays fully editable.
manage.startNeedsHint: Starting needs a complete setup and a pairing list — there is nothing to sail without one.
manage.closingHint: Declaring a day over, or calling it off, is a decision by the people on site — never a date passing. Both are reversible and neither deletes anything.
manage.finishNeedsLiveHint: An event that has not started cannot be declared over — but it can still be called off.
manage.finishedHint: Racing is over. Results stay editable: a protest heard weeks from now still lands here.
manage.cancelledHint: This event was called off. Nothing was deleted, and it counts in no series standings — being at a regatta that was called off costs nobody anything.
manage.printHint: The pairing list as a PDF: what crews take to the boat. Left empty, the font size follows the matchday's size — the sizes real league sheets are printed at.
manage.printFontHint: Points. Empty means derived from flights and races.
manage.liveHint: Left empty, the live view is this site's own map. Enter a URL when the day is shown elsewhere — a SAP Sailing race board, a club's page — and every live link of this event leads there.
manage.liveUrlHint: A full https:// address, or empty for the internal map.
manage.liveSavedExternal: Live links now lead to the external view.
manage.liveSavedInternal: The internal map is the live view again.
manage.waiversHint: Everyone in the participating squads and whether their waiver is on file — a series confirmation counts for this event too. Nothing is signed on the dock: the sailors do it from their own account page, minors upload the guardian's signed form.
manage.waiversNoVersion: No waiver text has been published yet.
manage.squadLimitsHint: This event belongs to no series, so its squad hangs off the entry itself. How many people may a club register for it? The maximum is enforced, the minimum shown to the club.

access.title: People
access.hint: Who runs this event: its managers, its race committee and its jury. Managers may add and remove people here.
access.empty: Nobody is named for this event yet — the league office and the host club's managers can still act.
